text: ‘We can use counting sort to sort the edge weights. This is possible because the weights are integers and in the range V'...2V. Recall that counting sort takes time O(n + k) where n is the number of items to sort and k the the maximum value in the set of numbers. In this case, n = |E|, and the range is |V|. Therefore the runtime of counting sort is O(E + V). As shown in class, the Find operations take time O(E) in total, and the merge operations take time O(V log V') in total. Therefore the overall runtime of this new version of Kruskal is O(E +V + Vlog V) = O(E +V log V) (as opposed to the original algorithm which takes O(Elog V). This version is asymptotically faster if there are few edges.
